story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain from code, not observed. A camera head atop a tower turns while its round display pans the dry land, then pulls back to the whole tower and its ring. 16 of 56 lens rings light. In the display a plume rises and a flag locks on it. An alert card slides out to a truck below and lands as a bubble on the dash phone inside the cab. The dash clock shows a hatched window up to ten minutes marked estimated. In the display the plume keeps burning under the locked flag. Wide, a dashed line from the truck stops short of a fire-station badge. A calendar clipped under the visors has no red mark. A blank record lies on the tailgate. The plan folder waits on state approval above the display, the landed alert and the open line.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on what the camera sees, answers by about 17 s with the alert in the crew truck, carries the same truck through the limits, and ends on a composite that restates the answer under the pending plan.
story_review.weakest_transition: s2 to s3: from a wall-view count card straight back into the display with no physical bridge. Acceptable because the display was established in s1.
